description: The pie chart illustrates the Token Routing Distribution in FedHLM, comparing the proportions of different categories. The chart is divided into three slices, representing the categories "FedHLM" (green), "LLM" (red), and "EDGE_P2P" (blue). The largest slice, "FedHLM", occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart, while "LLM" accounts for around 3.9%, and "EDGE_P2P" makes up about 1.6%. The percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A small gray legend or key is present at the bottom right of the chart, although its exact meaning is unclear. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, with "FedHLM" being the largest and "EDGE_P2P" being the smallest.
